title: 9M Analysis: Hazira gas terminal release and fire, 2020
audience: Investigators, HSE leads and the teams designing corrective and preventive actions
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document; draft: the investigation status is in progress

incident.title: Hazira gas terminal condensate release and fire

data_quality.text: Draft learnings from an unreviewed analysis: the ProbeMatrix investigation status is in progress and no finding is marked as edited by a person. Validate before adoption.

The answers come from a scripted replay (nine-m-replay --accept-recommended), which takes the recommended suggestion at every question. They show the method; the organisation's own interview replaces them.

bottom_line.text: All nine Ms are relevant on this export: the seed links every M to findings, and each scripted answer kept the M with one condition.
Management/Money (M6) holds the most level 3 and 4 findings in the seed: all 130 of its primary findings sit at levels 3 and 4, against 24 for Manpower/Mindpower (M1).

Material (M8) and Maintenance (M9) are under-coded: 9 and 27 findings by Nanocode, but 162 and 301 in all once their wording and clusters count. Both reached a condition through the relevance question.
One link crosses Ms: the maintenance and spares programme (OIR 1.6, M9) feeds risks identified but not mitigated (SVF 3.4, M6). It is kept as one learning (LR-05).
Every direction of change is at the elimination tier, the strongest offered. None names an owner or a date: the organisation sets those in the blank actions sheet.

rows: M2.09 Environmental Stressors and Extreme Conditions
M4.08 Organisational Culture and Mission Alignment
M9.07 Spare Parts and Inventory Management

items.lesson: A high-consequence seal job was staffed with no independent check role, so the part, the method and the missing test passed straight into service.
items.explanation: Subcategory M1.08 Communication and Coordination: nobody on the job was set up to check it and hand it over. The 18 Sep 2020 gasket job had no independent quality-check role, no hydrotest witness and no closing supervisor (OIS 4.2) [EVD-2894]. System driver: the maintenance and spares programme (OIR 1.6, level 4) feeds the gap in enforcing existing rules (SVV 4.1), and no return-to-service procedure existed to staff the job against. Barrier state: absent.

items.barrier: Independent check of pressure-boundary work before return to service
items.failure_mode: absent: no quality-check role, hydrotest witness or closing supervisor on the job

lint_ok.reason: the barrier records the administrative control the export shows was in place; the change for this condition is at the elimination tier

items.change: Corrective: remove the field reseal task from this class of joint, so that no crew has to judge the part, the method and the test alone. Pressure-boundary seals on the metering skid are restored by exchanging a shop-built assembly that has already passed its pressure test.
items.indicator: Pressure-boundary seal jobs on the skid done by assembly exchange, as a share of all such jobs

items.lesson: The vapour cloud made the leak area unreachable, and isolating the release depended on reaching it.
items.explanation: Subcategory M2.09 Environmental Stressors and Extreme Conditions. Dense vapour kept operating staff from approaching the metering area to find and isolate the source, a 41-minute delay before remote isolation (PTE 2.3) [EVD-1460]. System driver: a culture that allowed the unsafe set-up (OIC 2.1, level 4) feeds a workspace that did not fit the operation (PTE 2.8): the emergency valves could only be worked by hand at the valve. Barrier state: degraded.

items.barrier: Access to isolate the release at its source
items.failure_mode: degraded: the vapour cloud blocked the approach

lint_ok.reason: the barrier records the administrative control the export shows was in place; the change for this condition is at the elimination tier

items.change: Preventive: remove the need for anyone to approach a release to isolate it. Every emergency isolation point for the metering area is worked from outside the area a release can cover.
items.indicator: Emergency isolation points on the skid that can be worked without entering the release zone

items.lesson: A change and a high-risk job went ahead without the formal risk assessment the method required.
items.explanation: Subcategory M3.06 Risk Management Integration. The O-ring substitution never went through the management-of-change risk assessment, which had not been used for any change since 2018 [EVD-8645]; the gasket replacement ran on a maintenance notification with no job safety analysis, permit or procedure [EVD-5105]; and the emergency plan's risk assessment left out isolation criteria [EVD-4052] (SVIO 2.4, three findings). System driver: the maintenance and spares programme (OIR 1.6, level 4) feeds risks that were identified but not mitigated (SVF 3.4). Barrier state: absent.

items.failure_mode: absent: not applied to any change since 2018

lint_ok.reason: the barrier records the administrative control the export shows was in place; the change for this condition is at the elimination tier

items.change: Preventive: remove the route by which an unassessed substitution reaches the plant. The maintenance system cannot raise a job that fits a different pressure-boundary part until an approved management-of-change record is linked to it.
items.indicator: Part-substitution jobs raised without a linked management-of-change record (count)

items.lesson: The site's working doctrine made risky conditions normal: no isolation criteria in the emergency plan, breakdown repair for flameproof equipment, and unspecified seals as regular practice.
items.explanation: Subcategory M4.08 Organisational Culture and Mission Alignment, kept in M4 rather than M1 because it is what the organisation's doctrine made normal, not how a team was led day to day. The emergency plan named the major-leak scenario with no isolation criteria or authority [EVD-4052]; breakdown repair was preferred over preventive inspection in Zone 1 [EVD-9999]; and locally bought O-rings were 'regular practice' [EVD-8645] (OIP 3.5, three findings). System driver: formal risk assessment (SVIO 2.4, level 3) feeds mission planning (PTF 1.13). Barrier state: absent.

items.barrier: Emergency plan isolation criteria and delegated authority
items.failure_mode: absent: the plan named the scenario but not when to isolate or who decides

lint_ok.reason: the barrier records the administrative control the export shows was in place; the change for this condition is at the elimination tier

items.change: Corrective: remove the isolation decision from the escalation chain for a confirmed major leak. On confirmed detection the metering area is isolated at once, so nobody waits for a senior decision.
items.indicator: Major-leak drills: minutes from confirmed detection to isolation

items.lesson: Critical information reached supervision, but nothing in the system turned it into action: leak reports, an open malfunction notification and overdue audit recommendations all waited without a response.
items.explanation: Subcategory M5.11 Audits and Inspections. Verified heavy-leak reports reached the shift supervisors by 02:35 and no valve closed until 03:01 [EVD-6414]; the notification for the failed meter was never closed or reviewed [EVD-0591]; and 12 external-audit recommendations were extended without the required approval [EVD-6852] (SVI 1.6, three findings). System driver: the maintenance and spares programme (OIR 1.6, level 4) feeds risks that were identified but not mitigated (SVF 3.4); pipe-wall monitoring had slipped off its cycle. Barrier state: absent.

items.barrier: Supervisory response to critical leak information
items.failure_mode: absent: no trigger or criterion turned the reports into an isolation

lint_ok.reason: the barrier records the administrative control the export shows was in place; the change for this condition is at the elimination tier

items.change: Preventive: remove open-ended waiting on critical safety information. The maintenance and audit systems cannot close a safety-critical job or extend a safety recommendation without the review and approval each requires, so an open item cannot sit unseen.
items.indicator: Safety-critical notifications and audit recommendations past their date without approval (count)

items.lesson: Programmes ran without their risks being assessed: the seal substitution, the emergency plan's isolation criteria and emergency valves that could only be worked by hand.
items.explanation: Subcategory M6.05 Risk Management and Compliance. Locally bought O-rings replaced the lost OEM gasket with no specification, quality check, change review or recorded authority [EVD-8645]; the emergency plan never assessed isolation and stoppage criteria [EVD-4052]; and the risk that the manual valves would be unreachable in a release was never assessed [EVD-3932] (OIP 3.2, three findings). System driver: the maintenance and spares programme (OIR 1.6, level 4) feeds risks identified but not mitigated (SVF 3.4). The cross-M answer keeps that link as one learning, under M9 (LR-05), so it is not counted again here. Barrier state: absent.

items.failure_mode: absent: three programmes ran with their major-accident risk never assessed

lint_ok.reason: the barrier records the administrative control the export shows was in place; the change for this condition is at the elimination tier

items.change: Corrective: fund the removal of the hazard the unassessed emergency-valve programme left in place. Budget the replacement of the hand-worked emergency valves, so that isolating the terminal no longer depends on anyone entering the release area.
items.indicator: Hand-worked emergency isolation valves left in the terminal's release zones (count)

items.lesson: Ageing equipment stayed in service without upgrade or retirement: alarm-only gas detection, a 1986 meter with repeat seal failures, and emergency valves worked only by hand.
items.explanation: Subcategory M7.08 Lifecycle Management. Gas detection only displayed an alarm, with no shutdown or suppression interlock, so a leak detected at 02:12:50 became a 46-minute manual response [EVD-8657]; the 1986 meter stayed in service after three seal failures in 22 months [EVD-1494]; and the emergency valves were never upgraded to remote operation [EVD-3932] (OIR 1.7, three findings). System driver: leadership and supervisory oversight (SVI 1.1, level 3) feeds checklists not followed (ASBE 1.2). Barrier state: absent.

items.barrier: Automatic shutdown on confirmed gas detection

items.change: Corrective: retire the 1986 meter and its rectangular-slot joint, removing the seal that failed four times, and replace it with a design whose seal is specified and stocked.
items.indicator: Metering-skid joints in service with two or more seal failures in 24 months (count)

items.lesson: Parts and upgrades were not bought to a specification: the lost seal specification was never re-established, and pressure transmitters and gas-detection upgrades were never commissioned.
items.explanation: Subcategory M8.03 Material Compatibility. The OEM gasket specification was lost and never re-established, and unspecified local O-rings became regular practice [EVD-8645]; three pressure transmitters on the drawing sent no data to the control system [EVD-6470]; and gas detection was never upgraded to shut the plant down [EVD-8657] (OIR 1.5, three findings, 9 by Nanocode but 153 more by their wording). System driver: the maintenance and spares programme (OIR 1.6, level 4) feeds risks identified but not mitigated (SVF 3.4). Barrier state: absent.

items.failure_mode: absent: the OEM specification was lost and no substitute was approved

lint_ok.reason: the barrier records the administrative control the export shows was in place; the change for this condition is at the elimination tier

items.change: Preventive: remove unspecified seals from supply. Stores and purchasing hold and buy no pressure-boundary seal without an approved specification, so there is no unspecified part to fit.
items.indicator: Pressure-boundary seals in stores without an approved specification (count)

items.lesson: Repeat failures of the same joint were handled as routine repairs, and the maintenance system asked for no root-cause review, no return-to-service test and only breakdown-led electrical upkeep.
items.explanation: Subcategory M9.07 Spare Parts and Inventory Management. Three gasket replacements in about 22 months never led to a root-cause review, OEM spares or meter replacement [EVD-1494]; no hydrostatic test or return-to-service procedure followed the 18 Sep 2020 job [EVD-2894]; and electrical upkeep was breakdown-led, leaving a damaged flameproof lamp in Zone 1 [EVD-9999] (OIR 1.6, three findings). System driver: the same programme (OIR 1.6, level 4) feeds risks identified but not mitigated (SVF 3.4), the link the cross-M answer keeps as one learning with M6. Barrier state: degraded.

items.failure_mode: degraded: each failure was resealed as a routine job

lint_ok.reason: the barrier records the administrative control the export shows was in place; the change for this condition is at the elimination tier

items.change: Preventive: remove the repeat-reseal path. An item whose seal fails a second time leaves routine maintenance and stays out of service until its root cause is found and fixed.
items.indicator: Items with a second seal failure returned to service before a root-cause review (count)

nodes.label: M9 Maintenance: repeat seal failures handled as routine repairs (LR-05)
M6 Management/Money: programme risks never assessed

edges.label: OIR 1.6 feeds SVF 3.4: kept as one learning
